title: How Did October 7 Happen? Mehdi Asks a Former Israeli Intelligence Official
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
Three years ago, the world was left stunned by Hamas's brutal and horrific
surprise attack on Israel, in which the militant group killed over 1,000
Israelis and kidnapped over 250 people.

Yet, as details emerged about [warnings that went
ignored](https://www.timesofisrael.com/egypt-warned-netanyahu-of-attack-days-
before-oct-7-after-two-previous-warnings-report/) and the military's [slow
response](https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-67056987) to the October
7 attack, many began to ask - how much of a surprise attack was this?

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

**" It's quite clear that Mr. Netanyahu had been warned more than once,"
**former Israeli intelligence official **Avi Melamed** says to **Mehdi.**

In this 'Mehdi Unfiltered' interview, Mehdi asks Avi Melamed**** - who has
served in various intelligence and counterterrorism positions for the Israeli
government - some of the most crucial questions that have come out about
Israel's apparent lack of preparation around the October 7 attack, including:

  * Why Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu [dismissed](https://apnews.com/article/israel-netanyahu-hamas-war-gaza-warning-935c2cd82d3204d6dc859d296fc866e3) the UAE president's warning about an impending Hamas attack just 10 days before Oct. 7

  * Why Israeli military and intelligence officials [downplayed](https://www.nytimes.com/2023/11/30/world/middleeast/israel-had-a-blueprint-of-the-oct-7-attacks-a-year-ago-officials-dismissed-it.html) Hamas's battle plan, obtained a year before the attack

  * His reaction to [Hillary Clinton](https://www.newsweek.com/hillary-clinton-says-netanyahu-may-have-wanted-hamas-to-do-october-7-12428872) and the late [Charlie Kirk's](https://x.com/PBDsPodcast/status/2098440628015165648) questions and speculation around Israel's lack of preparation

  * Netanyahu's [refusal](https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/netanyahu-rejects-october-7-state-inquiry-claims-he-has-nothing-to-hide/) to do an internal investigation of his government's handling of the attack

  * If he concedes that Israel's war on Gaza was an operational [failure](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20260817-has-hamas-ended/)

Mehdi also brings the receipts and presses Melamed on whether he believes
Israel is committing a genocide in Gaza.
